Finding your signature scent

Follow the notes you love, then give a fragrance time to tell its story.

September 24, 2026

Start with what you already love

A cup of white tea, the warmth of vanilla, a fresh bouquet. Familiar aromas are a useful starting point when exploring fragrance.

Meet the fragrance slowly

Try one scent at a time. Notice the opening, then return to it after it has settled. Your favorite part may arrive later.

Make it personal

There is no single perfect choice for everyone. Choose the fragrance you enjoy wearing, and let your collection grow with your days.

Find the notes that feel like you.
